before.requirement: Provide a 32-element z_crc_t operator array to crc32_combine_gen(op, len2), then pass that array to crc32_combine_op.
before.reason: The old harness allocates the required array and uses the former generator and operator signatures.

after.requirement: Use the uLong returned by crc32_combine_gen(len2) as the scalar operator passed to crc32_combine_op.
after.reason: The fixed old harness passes two arguments to the one-argument generator and passes an array to the scalar operator.

claims.reason: The same CRC combine operation is compatible before and incompatible after because its operator representation changed.
